tasks.prompt:
Integration build loop for projectsites.dev. Worktree-isolated; commit disjoint files; push HEAD:main with the cron-safe stash dance.

Read `apps/project-sites/_LOOP_PROGRESS.md` and `~/.claude/projects/-Users-Apple-emdash-repositories-projectsites-dev/memory/integration-build-decisions.md` first.

BUILD ORDER (TDD-first, one service module per fire):
1. Listmonk transactional — `src/services/listmonk.ts` typed REST client (Zod, AGPL HTTP boundary). Use LISTMONK_API_KEY (get-secret), username=projectsites, base=https://mail.projectsites.dev/api. Start with `sendTransactional(templateId, subscriberEmail, data)` + `getSubscriber(email)`. Pure typed schemas, never-throw.
2. Twenty CRM — `src/services/twenty.ts` typed REST client. Use TWENTY_API_KEY (get-secret), base=https://crm.projectsites.dev/rest. Start with `findCompany(domain)` + `createContact(email, name)` + `upsertLead(companyId, data)`.
3. Integration health endpoints — `GET /api/integrations/:name/health` per service.
4. Listmonk marketing — `createCampaign`, `sendCampaign`, subscriber list management.

Each module: typed Zod schemas, co-located unit tests (jest), zero npm deps, never-throw, compatibility with Workers (no Node APIs). One module per fire. Commit + push each fire. Maintain _LOOP_PROGRESS.md.

Stop after 4 modules built or 2 hours elapsed. Deploy via CI push (not local wrangler).
